lead.headline: No scan results; Barkley's answer waits for Wednesday and his backup needs surgery
lead.deck: Finished at 63.7 to Team 13's 70.5 with Pitts to come. Fifty points sat on the bench. Rice and Waller are both off in Week 5, and one tight-end option firmed up.
lead.body: Two hamstrings decided it and by Monday afternoon neither had a published result. Saquon Barkley was hurt on his second carry, four snaps into the Rams game; his coach says he will 'have more answers for you probably Wednesday'. The back who replaced him, Tank Bigsby, is having core-muscle surgery and will miss about six weeks, which leaves Philadelphia one healthy runner. Rashee Rice pulled up after one catch in Las Vegas. On Sunday one reporter said several weeks; on Monday the Associated Press said the injury isn't considered serious. Those can't both be right and there is no scan to choose between them. Rice was sitting in Week 5 anyway, since Kansas City are on bye, and so is Darren Waller. The healthy starters didn't cover the gap: Garrett Wilson's Jets ran 32 plays, and Josh Downs drew four targets in a game the Colts led throughout. Jonathan Taylor's 22.7 was the exception. You finished on 63.68. Team 13 started two inactive players, have 70.52, and still have Kyle Pitts tonight. On your bench Carnell Tate caught nine of 12 targets for 145 yards and 21.5, Ollie Gordon ran for 100 and 18.0, and Matthew Golden and Bhayshul Tuten added 22.8 between them. No brief benched them; the projection did. Next week the receivers on that bench step in for Rice. The tight-end slot has nobody. Of the three candidates on waivers, Colston Loveland's condition was met today, because Caleb Williams is out and Tyson Bagent starts again; T.J. Hockenson still waits on Justin Jefferson and Mark Andrews on Lamar Jackson's ankle. Tomorrow's brief picks one and finds him a seat.

doFirst.headline: Nothing to set today; one conditional move for next week
doFirst.deck: Your lineup has played. Kamara is on the bench tonight and can't be moved in.
doFirst.note: When the week rolls: if Barkley is ruled out for London, Tuten takes his slot unless the Week 5 projection puts Gordon or Kamara two or more above him. Sirianni says Wednesday. The tight end for Waller's bye is Tuesday's decision, before claims process at 01:00 Wednesday.
doFirst.empty: Nothing to do this Monday: every starter has played. If Barkley is ruled out this week, Tuten takes his slot; the tight end for Waller's bye is tomorrow's call.

roster.deck: The lineup as set is the projection lineup. Barkley and Rice left injured, and the bench outscored the four slots it could have filled by 50.
